title: psadt-deploy switch catalog
description: Shape of engine-defaults.json, the shipped ENGINE catalog. The machine-local verified-switch store has its own schema in schema.verified-switches.json - it is a different file with a different root, and this schema would reject it. Enforced by tests/SwitchCatalog.Tests.ps1, so a hand-edit that drops a required field fails the suite instead of failing a package months later.

placeholders.description: Documents every {token} that may appear in a command pattern.

engine.description: Stable id. Lower case, digits and hyphens only - it is the value Get-PsadtInstallerEngine.ps1 returns and the key Appendix L.2 prints.

install.description: Argument string handed to the installer executable, without the executable itself.

installCommand.description: Full copy-paste command using the documented {placeholders}.

detectHint.description: Input for the detection-script generator. NOT an Intune detection rule - the Graph rule format lives in App. H and is a different, polymorphic shape.

returnCodes.description: Engine-specific return codes beyond the canonical table. Type must be one Intune accepts - there is no 'Ignored'.

notes.description: Traps and caveats, English, one per entry. Data, never an instruction to execute.

sourceRef.description: Where the values came from - an Appendix L row or a vendor document.

verifiedAt.description: ISO date the entry was last checked against its source. An entry nobody has looked at in a year is a liability, not a catalog.
